name: auto_write
install: python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r app/requirements.txt && python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages pytest

terminals.name: web-console
terminals.command: cd app && AUTO_WRITE_HOST=127.0.0.1 AUTO_WRITE_PORT=8765 python3 -m uvicorn auto_write.operator_main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
